round: V37 step 1: screen "progress" features for stage 3 by fitting realised scores
motivation: V36: one bias per second-largest-card group (3 parameters) on top of the shared P5 residual lowered validation MSE by 5.4% of the P5 gain (z=8.2), while separate tables per group underfit. Local 4-5 cell patterns do not express how far the board is from the second 6144. This step compares small global "progress" keys, each adding one bias weight per key value.

data.records: V33 records (training/v33-patterns/data/*.bin, 300 files): stage-3 afterstates of W31 website-search games from the 14,956 V27 training starts, 2 passes, every 2nd afterstate, target G = realised future score
data.limitation: collected under the old independent 1/21 bonus rule (before V35); the screen asks about representation, so the rule difference is accepted for this step

fit: training/v37-progress/fit.cpp: V36 fit.cpp with the bias keys below; shared P5 residual tables; everything else as V33/V36 (fixed V21 S3 base, validation = start index % 5 == 0, SGD 4 epochs .003/.001/.0003/.0001 seed 33, best validation epoch). Each key value is one extra feature in the multiplicity-normalised update.

keys.none: no bias (must reproduce V33 P5 exactly)
keys.s2: bucket of the second-largest card (6 values)
keys.mass: sum of card values >= 192 except one 6144, in units of 192, capped at 40 (41)

comparison: paired by validation start index vs none (z, V33 method); relative gain = (MSE_none - MSE_key) / (MSE_base_only - MSE_none); also each key vs bias3
decision: Eligible: keys with z > 2 and relative gain >= 5% vs none (bias3 included). Choice: among eligible keys within 0.5 percentage points of the best relative gain, the one with the fewest values. If a choice exists, the next step (separate protocol) adds that key to stage 3, trains with TD from the current V31 stage-3 tables (bias starting at 0, so the start equals V31) and evaluates paired continuations from first-6144 positions under the cycle rule. If none is eligible, stop.
